about.title: We are Zuzia
about.image_alt: Zuzia and Ben laughing as they cut their wedding cake
paragraphs: Our story began when we met a few years back. Over time we became friends, and through the ups and downs our relationship grew stronger. In March 2023 we promised to love and support one another, and got married.
Photography and film helped us make new connections and grow, as people and as a couple. Now our goal is simple: to help others capture their stories and keep their most precious memories forever.

reviews.featured_quote: The trust you give to those capturing the biggest day of your life is a big responsibility, but I honestly could not recommend them enough.

pricing.intro: One price for your whole wedding day. No hourly packages and no watching the clock: we stay for as long as you need us.
